rules.alternatives: No separate state hour count: renewal requires proof of current NCCPA certification (or another board-approved certifying agency); an emergency deferral of up to one year is possible if NCCPA recertification is not passed before expiry.

topics.who: PAs holding both a DEA registration and a New Mexico controlled substances registration; pain management with controlled substances (pharmacology/risks, abuse and diversion, regulations, pain treatment), earned in the 2 years before renewal; may also count for NCCPA
All board licensees with DEA and NM controlled substances registrations: 5 hours in pain management during the first year of licensure (counts toward the renewal hours)

rules.notes: PA licenses expire March 1 of the year following expiration of NCCPA certification; late renewal allowed with fees until suspension for non-renewal on June 1. Proof of CME is submitted directly to the board.
